name_in_paper: T cell receptor (TCR) dependent activation induced marker (AIM) assays

evidence.quote: We utilized T cell receptor (TCR) dependent activation induced marker (AIM) assays to identify and quantify SARS-CoV-2-specific CD4 + T cells in recovered COVID-19 patients.
Supernatants were harvested at 24 hours post-stimulation for multiplex detection of cytokines.
